decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1.	The proposed self-contained flat, by reason of design and layout, is not considered to be acceptable. The proposal would result in unsatisfactory levels of light within the living area of the dwelling. The proposal is therefore contrary to H.3.4 (Conversions of Houses to Flats), H.4.1 (Housing Standards and Guidelines) and ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) of the Unitary Development Plan and the Supplementary Planning Guidance.

Condition : 2 - 2.	The proposed self-contained flat would not provide a sufficient level of outdoor amenity space and the outdoor amenity space would be directly overlooked by the raised landing and stairs for the ground floor flat. The proposal is therefore contrary to H.3.4 (Conversions of Houses to Flats), H.4.1 (Housing Standards and Guidelines) and ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) of the Unitary Development Plan and the Supplementary Planning Guidance.

Condition : 3 - 3.	The proposed self-contained flat is not considered to satisfy Planning Policy Statement 25 and would result in an unacceptable level of flood risk to future occupiers. The subject site is located within Flood Zone 3 where self-contained basement flats are highly vulnerable. No exception test has been provided. The proposal has not satisfied Planning Policy Statement 25 in this regard.
description: Erection of a two storey rear extension and conversion of basement into a self contained flat.
